target: Linux ARM64; production Maven clean package -Dmaven.test.skip=true

enforcement.artifactAcquisition: Empty destination; exact size/SHA256; reviewed HTTPS origins; no proxy/redirect fallback.
enforcement.maven: All inputs verified before Maven; offline local repository and Docker RUN --network=none.
enforcement.debian: All local archives verified before dpkg; install/configure with Docker RUN --network=none; installed identities compared.
enforcement.apk: All local archives verified before apk; no repositories/network/scripts; installed identities compared.
enforcement.npm: Existing official-registry integrity locks; install lifecycle scripts disabled; only reviewed Vue local initializers and compilation execute offline.
enforcement.python: Existing exact wheel/hash lock; binary wheels only; no dependency resolver or model downloader added.

limits: Not a formal supply-chain attestation, vulnerability scan or license audit.
Reviewed production goal/platform only; POM/base/architecture changes require explicit lock regeneration and review.
Archives removed by upstream cause a closed build failure, not substitution.
Test-observer images are recorded separately; they are not deployed backend base images.
Final locked-image synthetic DNS/egress gate passes after the approved local-IP fix; final owner acceptance and live cutover are not implied.

sourceOnlyRebuild.reason: Approved local-IP probe removal and regression tests
